thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2: spike in 5xx + gateway timeouts in us-east-1. alerting thresholds crossed at 12:04 UTC. initial metric: 5xx-rate=18% (baseline 0.6%), 429-rate=7%. paging oncall.

sarah: seeing perf dashboards now — spike started ~12:02, very sharp. streaming endpoints most affected. some 504s and gateway timeouts too.

kyle: I can repro in staging load tests — gateway is returning 504 when upstream returns 429. suspect quota enforcement misconfig cascading into proxy timeouts. pulling ratelimiter logs.

maria: customer impact: 3 customers reported errors via webhook (AcmeCorp, ZephyrApp, internal-instrumentation). Acme is hitting heavy generation endpoints. sending heads-up to CS.

opsbot: Roll forward note: recent config change "tenant-burst-override" deployed 11:58 UTC to primary global-quota service (commit c3f8a7b).

kyle: Confirmed -- global-quota started rejecting at ~12:01 after a bad merge where a default cap for shared-tenants was lowered from 2000 -> 200. Logs: 429s spike correlated with config rollout.

sarah: timeline makes sense. Once quota service started 429-ing, the gateway retried aggressively and hit connection queueing -> 504s. Need to stop cascade.

jen: Suggested immediate mitigations: 1) rollback quota change 2) enable proxy retry-suppression (so gateway doesn't hammer upstream) 3) route critical tenants to standby quota node. I'll do 1 & 2 if ops agrees.

alex (oncall): I'm taking pager. moving to #war-room voice. Assigning tasks: kyle (quota rollback & validation), sarah (observe gateway backpressure), jen (proxy config change + fallback routing), maria (customer comms).

kyle: rolling back config now — running:
``` 
kubectl -n infra apply -f /deploys/quota/defaults/rollback-tenant-burst-2026-03-15.yaml
``` 
Monitoring global-quota logs for successful reconciliation.

opsbot: Deploy accepted, config reconciler applied.

kyle: quota service reconciled at 12:08 UTC. I've verified per-tenant caps restored to previous values. 429s dropping in the quota logs.

sarah: Gateway 5xx rate already trending down. 5xx-rate now 4.2%, 429-rate 1.1%. Latency reduced on streaming endpoints.

jen: Enabled gateway retry-suppression and lowered retry attempts to 1 for upstream=global-quota. Pushed fallback routing: any tenant hitting >10% errors will be routed to small-model-variant to reduce compute pressure.

maria: Customer comms: sent proactive note to AcmeCorp + ZephyrApp: "We've identified transient quota misconfiguration causing elevated errors; mitigation in progress; monitoring. We will follow up with RCA."

alex (oncall): Good. Next steps: keep monitoring for 30m, run a targeted regression test for streaming flows, prepare RCA stub. If errors remain above 2% 5xx we escalate to SEV1.

kyle: Running regression load now. Results look normal on core endpoints. No error cascade visible in us-east-1.

sarah: Confirming synthetic checks green across regions except a few residual timeouts in one gateway pod — I'll restart that pod to clear connection queues.

opsbot: Pod restart performed: gateway-prod-7c9f restarted at 12:22 UTC by sarah.

jen: Quick note for postmortem: the root cause was a bad default applied during a refactor of tenant overrides. We need a rollout guard in config-reconciler to prevent applying caps < X for shared-tenants. Also add canary rollout for quota config.

maria: CS will follow up with impacted customers with post-incident summary and timeline.

alex (oncall): I'll stay on for another 35 minutes for handoff to next oncall. Pushing an incident update to incident tracker: SEV-2 -> mitigated.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated (12:24 UTC). Please file postmortem ticket and link logs/traces.

sarah: :thumbsup: good work. Noting action items: 1) RC guard for quota defaults (jen/kyle) 2) Canary config rollout for quota service (eng-sre) 3) Update gateway retry policy to avoid retry storms (jen) 4) CS follow-up (maria).

alex (oncall): Handoff complete at 12:29 UTC to night oncall. leaving notes in pager duty. If anything regresses ping me.

kyle: I'll draft a short RCA PR and include the faulty config diff and timeline.

jen: Also adding an automated alert to detect config diffs that reduce caps by >90% in <5m.

maria: Closing loop with Acme — they acknowledged and will hold off opening a formal incident until we send RCA.

incident-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0315-qt-01.

sarah: Closing thread, moving details to postmortems/ and tickets. :white_check_mark:
